tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Search Slabline's catalogue of 1.5M+ graded cards (PSA/BGS/SGC/CGC) by player, set, or year. Returns up to 10 matches with their current Slabline value, highest-value first.

tools.name: value_card
tools.description: Get one card's current Slabline value: graded market value, raw/loose value, and the across-grades total. Pass a slug from search_cards, or a free-text query (the top match is used). Values are Slabline-derived from real comparable sales; individual sale rows are not returned.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Slabline for graded trading cards (sports & TCG) by player, set, or year. Returns matches, each with an id to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one Slabline card by id (the slug returned by search): its current graded market value, raw/loose value, and across-grades total.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
